description.value: The Museum of the Cariboo-Chilcotin is a regional history museum in Williams Lake and the home of the BC Cowboy Hall of Fame, with exhibits spanning First Nations peoples, ranching and rodeo culture, railway history, mining, and forestry. The museum features rotating exhibitions including a powerful collection documenting the 2017 Cariboo Chilcotin wildfires. Located directly off Highway 97, it offers touring cyclists a rich cultural detour into the deep heritage of British Columbia's interior.
